_comment: What the free plugin ships, by content hash -- except for the five
files listed under "generated", whose bytes a second machine cannot
reproduce (webpack output, and the Composer autoloader files that embed
the install path). Those are recorded by path.
tests/Packaging/zip.test.mjs has the reasoning, and asserts that the
list of five has not grown.
First recorded from dist/debloater-0.1.1.zip at commit 699eace, the
artifact that was about to go to wordpress.org, so that splitting Pro
out of this repository could be proved not to have changed the plugin.
not run without a reason, and the reason lands in "history" below.

history.why: Phase 19c added profiles: the export schema, Profile, ProfileStore and three REST routes, with the CLI, Plugin and four src/Update files altered. Five files moved from content hashes to path records -- webpack's bundle, its asset manifest, and the three Composer autoloader files that embed the install path -- because their bytes differ between machines and pinning them had kept the package job red since the Pro split.

composer.json gained the check:packaging script and its description. Recorded separately from the phase 19c entry above because the archive was rebuilt after that edit, and the record is meant to name each change rather than absorb it.

0.2.0: profiles across the CLI, the screen and a URL contract; the registry signing key pinned and signed bytes verified before parsing; the verification cookie fix; reproducible archives. The shipped code had changed repeatedly since 0.1.1 with the version never moving.

0.2.0: profiles across the CLI, the screen and a URL contract; the registry signing key pinned and signed bytes verified before parsing; the verification cookie fix; reproducible archives. Includes the DEBLOATER_VERSION constant, which the first pass at this bump missed.
0.3.0: renamed to hakeemify-debloater; the compiled runtime and mu-loader removed (D-0070); Level B spill moved to uploads (D-0072)
0.3.0: renamed to hakeemify-debloater; the compiled runtime and mu-loader removed (D-0070); Level B spill moved to uploads (D-0072)
0.3.0: renamed to hakeemify-debloater; compiled runtime and mu-loader removed (D-0070); Level B spill moved to uploads (D-0072); phpcs suppressions moved inline so Plugin Check sees them (P9)

0.4.0: wordpress.org review round 2. The registry fetch removed (RegistryOrigin, RegistryUpdater, SignatureVerifier, UpdateCheck; D-0073); exports only to uploads, --file takes only - (D-0074); a rolled-back tweak re-applied is recorded as committed (D-0075); assets attributed in URL space, per-asset bytes removed, promo-notice handler and admin menu and mu-plugin detection build no paths (D-0076); admin.hide_update_nags_non_admins, its handler and UpdateNagRule removed (D-0077).

0.4.0: wp debloater status text output read runtime keys removed in 0.3.0 and logged PHP warnings under WP_DEBUG; found on the clean-install test of the 0.4.0 archive. Command.php, readme.txt changelog line, .pot.
